categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Configures and enables the `optin.performance.Padding` clang-tidy analyzer check with a 24-byte threshold.
categories.rationale: Enables an automated static analysis check to guard against future struct padding and memory layout regressions. While preventing unintended memory bloat is worthwhile, adding optional static analysis checks does not address release integrity, platform breakages, or CI reliability.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Reordering member fields in CNode, CConnman, and Peer is a mechanical change driven by the clang-tidy check rather than any P2P protocol or networking logic change.
categories.rationale: Does not alter P2P behavior, interfaces, or protocol logic; field reordering to reduce padding is an internal layout adjustment incidental to the tooling change.
